title: Edge Weight Assignment
statementMd:
You have unweighted tree of $n$ vertices. You have to assign a **positive** weight to each edge so that the following condition would hold:

- For every two different leaves $v_{1}$ and $v_{2}$ of this tree, [bitwise XOR](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitwise_operation#XOR) of weights of all edges on the simple path between $v_{1}$ and $v_{2}$ has to be equal to $0$.

Note that you can put **very large** positive integers (like $10^{(10^{10})}$).

It's guaranteed that such assignment always exists under given constraints. Now let's define $f$ as **the number of distinct weights** in assignment.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5b0101e1310bed98e055bbf14738361d76eac0d7.png) In this example, assignment is valid, because bitwise XOR of all edge weights between every pair of leaves is $0$. $f$ value is $2$ here, because there are $2$ distinct edge weights($4$ and $5$).![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0069cd7e09cedad856e36260655c8bbd4f42062f.png) In this example, assignment is invalid, because bitwise XOR of all edge weights between vertex $1$ and vertex $6$ ($3, 4, 5, 4$) is not $0$.

What are the minimum and the maximum possible values of $f$ for the given tree? Find and print both.

## Input

The first line contains integer $n$ ($3 \le n \le 10^{5}$) — the number of vertices in given tree.

The $i$-th of the next $n-1$ lines contains two integers $a_{i}$ and $b_{i}$ ($1 \le a_{i} \lt b_{i} \le n$) — it means there is an edge between $a_{i}$ and $b_{i}$. It is guaranteed that given graph forms tree of $n$ vertices.

## Output

Print two integers — the minimum and maximum possible value of $f$ can be made from valid assignment of given tree. Note that it's always possible to make an assignment under given constraints.

## Note

In the first example, possible assignments for each minimum and maximum are described in picture below. Of course, there are multiple possible assignments for each minimum and maximum.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8c3ca6ef35ed8818b24c63d36c4f1fe419bb545c.png)

In the second example, possible assignments for each minimum and maximum are described in picture below. The $f$ value of valid assignment of this tree is always $3$.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/97d4c3d0db0f70bfbf3cc4fa8ba0a2691a95320e.png)

In the third example, possible assignments for each minimum and maximum are described in picture below. Of course, there are multiple possible assignments for each minimum and maximum.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2cd034f9908e3131bc593c352126e15712c58763.png)
statementZhMd:
给定一棵有 $n$ 个顶点的无权树。你需要为每条边分配一个**正**权值，使其满足以下条件：

- 对于这棵树的任意两个不同的叶子节点 $v_{1}$ 和 $v_{2}$，它们之间简单路径上所有边的权值按位 [异或](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bitwise_operation#XOR) 的结果必须等于 $0$。

注意，你可以使用**非常大的**正整数（例如 $10^{(10^{10})}$）。

保证在给定约束下，总是存在满足条件的分配方案。现在定义 $f$ 为分配方案中**不同权值的数量**。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/5b0101e1310bed98e055bbf14738361d76eac0d7.png) 在这个例子中，分配方案是有效的，因为任意一对叶子节点之间所有边的权值按位异或结果都是 $0$。这里的 $f$ 值为 $2$，因为有 $2$ 种不同的边权值（$4$ 和 $5$）。![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/0069cd7e09cedad856e36260655c8bbd4f42062f.png) 在这个例子中，分配方案是无效的，因为顶点 $1$ 和顶点 $6$ 之间所有边的权值（$3, 4, 5, 4$）按位异或的结果不为 $0$。

对于给定的树，$f$ 可能的最小值和最大值是多少？请找出并输出这两个值。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $n$（$3 \le n \le 10^{5}$）——给定树的顶点数。

接下来的 $n-1$ 行中，第 $i$ 行包含两个整数 $a_{i}$ 和 $b_{i}$（$1 \le a_{i} \lt b_{i} \le n$），表示顶点 $a_{i}$ 和 $b_{i}$ 之间存在一条边。保证给定的图是一棵含有 $n$ 个顶点的树。

## 输出格式

输出两个整数——通过给定树的有效分配方案可以得到的 $f$ 的最小值和最大值。注意，在给定约束下，总是可以构造出分配方案。

## 说明

在第一个样例中，下面的图片描述了使 $f$ 取最小值和最大值时的可能分配方案。当然，对于最小值和最大值，可能存在多个不同的分配方案。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8c3ca6ef35ed8818b24c63d36c4f1fe419bb545c.png)

在第二个样例中，下面的图片描述了使 $f$ 取最小值和最大值时的可能分配方案。这棵树的有效分配方案的 $f$ 值始终为 $3$。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/97d4c3d0db0f70bfbf3cc4fa8ba0a2691a95320e.png)

在第三个样例中，下面的图片描述了使 $f$ 取最小值和最大值时的可能分配方案。当然，对于最小值和最大值，可能存在多个不同的分配方案。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/2cd034f9908e3131bc593c352126e15712c58763.png)
